comment: Variation of level-info-ledger-16708-wished-portal-arrival: another seed gives another tune and ledger 17987, a different subroom slot of svr.rooms[], and a level whose creation prints builds_up()'s impossible() report through level_difficulty() 77 times. The 250 spaces answer every --More-- of the arrival, so the recording ends after the level is complete: the port queues the reports of its synchronous level_difficulty() callers and draws ahead of C's PRNG log while one is still waiting.
